description: This file defines the API controller class for the admin user module in OpenCart, handling user API related functionalities such as listing, viewing, editing, and deleting APIs. It builds responses for API endpoints, loads models and views, and manages request parameters.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: Controller class managing user APIs in the admin panel, including listing APIs, viewing details, editing, and deleting APIs.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to render the user API dashboard, listing existing APIs and providing navigation and actions.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the API endpoint to list user APIs with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of APIs from the model based on current filter and sorting parameters and prepares view data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the API endpoint to show a list of user API details with sort and pagination options.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and returns a paginated, sorted list of APIs based on request parameters.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Handles displaying the API creation/edit form, populating data if editing an existing API.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving API data submitted from the form, either creating or updating an API record.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected APIs based on request data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving API data submitted from the form, either creating or updating an API record with permission checks and JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected APIs based on request data, with permission validation and JSON output.

methods.name: deleteSession
methods.description: Deletes a session by session ID, including permission verification and JSON response.
